## Review Questions

- According to the Informal Networks article, why is it important to identify different kinds of networks?
- What sorts of information can be learned from an advice network?
	- A trust network?
- Have you thought about the groups that you are in from a network perspective? What insights have you had?

## Technology break!

## Review Questions

- What is network hierarchy? How does it differ from organizational hierarchy?
- What is a core-periphery structure?
- What is a structural hole?
- What is multiplexity?

## Discussion Questions

- Can network analysis predict what new structure will emerge after a key actor enters or exits, rather than only describing the structural change after it has already occurred?
- Why do people seek more important information out of a weaker tie when they trust the stronger tie more? How do they know that the weaker tie is telling the truth?
- How can an organization intentionally improve its informal network without making the relationships feel forced or artificial? 

## Discussion Questions

- How do researchers determine whether a certain network structure actually caused a group to perform better, rather than the group performing well first and developing a stronger network afterward? 
- What is one positive experience you've had where you felt like you could reach goals better in a decentralized network?
- Thinking about a group project or team you've been part of, was the person who was actually "in charge" on paper the same person that everyone went to for help or advice? If not, what made the other person more central even without the title of being in charge?
